_comment: BCNF data-source provenance dimension + current-ingest rows. 'sources' is the data-source dimension keyed by id (uri is a 2nd candidate key, unique). 'ingested' is the single CURRENT ingest per source keyed by source_id (FK to sources); it carries NO uri — the uri is reached by joining to sources via source_id (BCNF: the transitive uri->id dependency is normalized out). ingested_at is a COMMITTED SNAPSHOT timestamp, NEVER computed at load or codegen time — pinning it here is what keeps generated output byte-deterministic. The registry attestation rule (registry.go aggregate): every static row attests models.dev (empty Source means the models.dev origin is implicit); an enriched row whose Source names a further source (e.g. ollama) DUAL-attests both models.dev AND that source.
